test.create_query: CREATE TABLE text_index_materialize_all ( id UInt64, s String, INDEX idx s TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha, posting_list_codec = 'none') ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO text_index_materialize_all SELECT number, arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat('w', toString(toUInt64(exp((cityHash64(number, i) % 1000000000) / 1e9 * log(200000))))), range(10)), ' ') FROM numbers(10000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM text_index_materialize_all WHERE hasAllTokens(s, ['w1', 'w10'])
SELECT count() FROM text_index_materialize_all WHERE hasAllTokens(s, ['w1', 'w2', 'w3'])
SELECT sum(id) FROM text_index_materialize_all WHERE hasAllTokens(s, ['w1', 'w2'])
